name: Cannonade
description: Cannon blocks sit on top of hidden marble boxes. Tap any box next to a Cannon and it fires a replacement box into the empty slot — keeping the grid loaded while slowly shrinking. When the shared ammo runs dry, the Cannons crumble and reveal the marble boxes they were protecting.
howToPlay: Tap the colored boxes on either side of the grey Cannon blocks. Each tap triggers a cannon fire — watch the muzzle flash and the new box pop into place. After enough fires the Cannons will crumble and reveal hidden boxes underneath. Keep tapping until every marble is sorted!
